sloka: कच्चिन्न सर्वे कर्मान्ता: प्रत्यक्षास्ते ऽविशङ्कया ।सर्वे वा पुनरुत्सृष्टा मध्यमेवात्र कारणम् ॥ २.१००.५३॥
transliteration: kaccinna sarve karmāntā: pratyakṣāste 'viśaṅkayā ।sarve vā punarutsṛṣṭā madhyamevātra kāraṇam ॥ 2.100.53॥

translations.english: Hope all the forts are adequately provided with wealth, foodgrains, weapons and water, with machines of war and craftsmen and archers.
